messages:
maria: PR 18188 is green locally and ready, but mac e2e is flaky in CI. Need a quick canary before tonight's deploy blackout. Anyone available for a 18:30 UTC canary? /cc @julie
alex: can run mac matrix, re-running now.
ci-bot: Re-run requested by alex — mac-e2e (job 7443) queued.
sam: saw the failure earlier — looks like /tmp/env isn't set in the runner. pushing tiny fix.
maria: pushed fix + rebased onto main. command I ran: `git rebase main && git push -f`
julie: 18:30 UTC works for me, I can watch canary. is it rebased and passing mac?
alex: jobs passing except flaky test `render_widget_test` failing 1/10. rerunning just that job: `./infra/ci/run_job.sh mac-e2e render_widget_test`
ci-bot: Job rerun started — render_widget_test (job 7446).
alex: looks transient, failure is a timeout in headless chrome. lowering timeout in test now.
sam: pushed timeout bump, no functional change.
maria: thanks. can someone add an approval so I can land? @taylor
taylor: approved for canary only :thumbsup:
julie: ok I'll take canary at 18:30 UTC. if anything breaks we'll rollback to tagged commit.
maria: scheduling canary, setting deploy flag `canary=true` and tagging commit `pr-18188-canary`
alex: note: if canary fails, please open an incident channel and ping eng-oncall.
maria: noted — will do. thanks y'all
